title: Redesign /project detail page
description: Re-design the Project Detail Page (/project/:id). The current implementation has a 4-tab layout (Overview, Tasks, OKR, Notes) with code-split lazy loading, a ProjectProvider context, and a QuickAddFAB. The Overview tab packs 7 dashboard cards (HealthScore, TaskProgress, OkrSummary, WorkContext, Insight, Coaching, ActivityTimeline) which may be overwhelming. Project settings (AI instructions, role, sources, memories, conversations) are backend-ready but have no UI surface.
considerations: Overview tab has 7 cards — consider reducing to essential metrics or making cards collapsible
Project settings (instructions, role, sources) have backend commands but no UI — surface in redesign
project_conversations_list, project_memories_list, project_source_* need UI panels
Health score formula (60% OKR, 20% task velocity, 10% insights, 10% focus) may need tuning
QuickAddFAB could be replaced with inline creation or command palette integration
Consider sidebar+content layout vs current tab layout
GlassTabBar with drag-reorder is nice but tabs may not scale if more sections are added

title: Complete migration from ActionRepo/actions to TaskRepo/tasks
description: ActionRepo and the actions table are the legacy task system, replaced by feature-tasks/TaskRepo/tasks table. However, ActionRepo is still actively used by 26 files across 6 crates (agent, tools, activity-log, feature-tasks, app-core, storage). This is a full migration effort: port all ActionRepo callers to TaskRepo, then drop actions + action_attachments + action_dependencies + action_time_entries tables. focus_sessions already removed (replaced by productivity_sessions). custom_column_values FK already fixed to reference tasks(id).
considerations: 26 files across 6 crates reference ActionRepo — this is NOT a table drop, it's a full migration
Agent runtime services (reminders, recurring_tasks) depend on ActionRepo — must port to TaskRepo
activity-log context_action_repo queries actions table directly — must be rewritten
plugin-runtime host uses ActionRepo for WASM plugin actions — verify plugin API compatibility
Pre-release: no data migration needed, but code migration is substantial

title: Remove dead/unimplemented tables from migrations
description: Remove tables that exist in migrations but have zero code writing to them. These are placeholder schemas for features that were never implemented.
considerations: calendar_* may be needed if CalDAV integration is planned — check roadmap before removing
work_context_* tables are part of activity-log crate — may be Phase 2 planned feature
Pre-release: safe to drop, but verify no future spec references these tables

title: Implement adaptive note intents (study/research/capture)
description: Make notes purpose-aware via notebook-level intent default + per-note override. Study notes get full learning pipeline (atoms, flashcards, FSRS). Research notes get evidence maps, source trails, cross-domain links. Capture notes get clean editor with lightweight enrichment only.
